tutorials.goal_zh: 在 285–330 K 内把 PATH 转为 HUMS，并把 PERO 转为 WATR。
tutorials.goal_en: Keep the treatment in 285–330 K and convert PATH to HUMS and PERO to WATR.
tutorials.hint_zh: 让两种粒子保持相邻并关闭重力。
tutorials.hint_en: Keep the two particles adjacent with gravity disabled.
tutorials.result_zh: 病原体已被处理，水和腐殖质可继续进入回收链。
tutorials.result_en: The pathogen is treated; water and humus can enter recovery chains.

tutorials.goal_zh: 加入保持高温的 CATA，使不安全的 PERO/PATH 处理停止。
tutorials.goal_en: Add a catalyst that stays hot so unsafe PERO/PATH treatment stops.
tutorials.hint_zh: CATA 初温要有余量，且低于熔化上限。
tutorials.hint_en: Give CATA thermal margin while staying below its melt limit.
tutorials.result_zh: 热催化剂联锁有效，输入未被误消耗。
tutorials.result_en: The hot-catalyst interlock works and inputs are not consumed.

tutorials.goal_zh: 补足 WATR 后把 HUMS/FERT 回收为 NUTR/DUST。
tutorials.goal_en: Add WATR and recover HUMS/FERT into NUTR/DUST.
tutorials.hint_zh: 缺水时反应必须保持停止。
tutorials.hint_en: The reaction must remain stopped while water is missing.
tutorials.result_zh: 营养盐已回收，水仍保留。
tutorials.result_en: Nutrient is recovered and water is retained.

tutorials.goal_zh: 在温和温区用 CATA/ACID 将 SLAG 回收为 FLUX/WATR。
tutorials.goal_en: Use CATA and ACID in the mild window to recover SLAG into FLUX/WATR.
tutorials.hint_zh: 超过 340 K 时应先停机冷却。
tutorials.hint_en: Cool down before operating above 340 K.
tutorials.result_zh: 炉渣已变成可回炉助熔剂。

tutorials.goal_zh: 用熔融 LEAD 和 SPRK(NCRM) 将 SSIL 组装成两份 RSHD。
tutorials.goal_en: Use molten LEAD and SPRK(NCRM) to assemble SSIL into two RSHD particles.
tutorials.hint_en: Keep SSIL and LEAD in the 700–1200 K assembly window.
tutorials.result_zh: 屏蔽体已组装，可以吸收局部中子。
tutorials.result_en: The shields are assembled and can absorb local neutrons.

tutorials.goal_zh: 补入 CATA 后才允许冷却废物稳定化。
tutorials.goal_en: Only allow cooled-waste stabilization after adding CATA.
tutorials.hint_zh: 先观察缺 CATA 时输入保持不变，再补入催化剂。
tutorials.hint_en: Observe unchanged inputs without CATA, then add the catalyst.
tutorials.result_zh: 危险废物已进入受限稳定化链。
tutorials.result_en: Hazardous waste enters the bounded stabilization chain.

tutorials.goal_zh: 在 500–620 K 内保留水和催化剂，并生成 RSHD/FLUX/NUTR。
tutorials.goal_en: Within 500–620 K retain water and catalyst while producing RSHD/FLUX/NUTR.
tutorials.hint_zh: 输入不全或过热时不要强行运行。
tutorials.hint_en: Do not force the process with incomplete or overheated inputs.
tutorials.result_zh: 四模块废物链完成且粒子数不增加。
tutorials.result_en: The four-module waste chain completes without particle growth.

tutorials.goal_zh: 一次运行四条链，核对生态、化学、冶金和核工业输出。
tutorials.goal_en: Run all four chains once and verify ecology, chemistry, metallurgy and nuclear outputs.
tutorials.hint_zh: 保持四个 3x3 区域分离，避免跨区误触发。
tutorials.hint_en: Keep the four 3x3 areas separated to avoid cross-triggering.
tutorials.result_zh: 综合恢复完成，四模块预算和局部边界保持有效。
tutorials.result_en: Integrated recovery completes with local bounds and shared budgets intact.
